description: Get the owner-verified details of one business by slug (from search_businesses): description, phone, address, opening hours, closed days, services and products with prices, offer ids, stock left, service lengths, how booking works there (by service or by table with party size), whether it confirms instantly, and how the customer pays the business. Call this before get_available_times and create_request: it says which kind of request the business takes ('can') and gives the offer_id / service_id values to send. Read-only, no side effects. No sign-in or API key needed. Rate limit: 600 read calls and 60 create_request calls per hour per client IP; over the limit you get error -32000 'Too many requests' (wait, then retry).

slug.description: The business's id from search_businesses (the 'slug' field).

name: get_business
title: Get business details
